recipe.visualDefinition: A central, large industrial cogwheel containing three bold block letters, set against a clean white background with secondary text at the top and bottom. The gear and central letters feature a mottled, weathered metallic texture with pink and bronze undertones.
coreVisualRelationships: Central gear framing the primary acronym
Symmetrical vertical alignment of all elements
Soft drop shadows creating depth against a flat white field
Contrast between weathered industrial textures and clean typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The gear and central letters occupy the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central cogwheel and its inner block lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top text leads down to the central gear, then down to the bottom footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central icon, focusing all attention on the industrial motif.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mottled pink and bronze for the metallic gear texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation textures paired with high-value background and high-contrast dark text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Central letters are clipped or shaped to fit within the circular interior of the gear
Secondary text uses a condensed, heavy sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block lettering for the focal point paired with condensed sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the secondary text.
Captures the industrial aesthetic of the central letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-resolution 12-toothed industrial gear silhouette centered on a pure white background. Apply a weathered, mottled metallic texture to the gear consisting of pink, bronze, and copper tones. Add a soft, diffuse drop shadow behind the gear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place three large, bold block letters inside the gear's center using the same metallic texture. Add condensed bold sans-serif text in a deep maroon color at the very top and bottom of the frame, centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the gear texture mottled and metallic?
Are there soft drop shadows on the central elements?
Is the secondary text condensed and maroon?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic corrosion texture
Specific hue of the secondary text
Weight of the central block letters
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gear is perfectly centered.
Verify the texture looks like weathered metal, not just noise.
Check that the drop shadow doesn't look like a hard outline.
Confirm the white background is clean and free of artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Gear + Mottled Metal Texture + Heavy Block Typography + Minimalist White Space = Industrial Graphic Aesthetic
